# Herend China Guide by Paris Tableware

> An independent guide to Herend china (hand-painted porcelain from Herend, Hungary): the Rothschild Bird, Queen Victoria, Princess Victoria, Chinese Bouquet (Apponyi) and Golden Edge patterns, tea sets, place settings, care and registries. Written by Paris Tableware, a family-owned store in Ridgewood, New Jersey, since 1982. Prices and stock are on paristableware.com.

- [Home](https://herendchina.com/): How to tell Herend china patterns apart, from Rothschild Bird and Queen Victoria to Chinese Bouquet and Golden Edge, and how to buy genuine pieces.

## Herend china patterns

- [Herend Rothschild Bird: A Guide to the Pattern](https://herendchina.com/rothschild-bird/): Herend Rothschild Bird explained: the twelve hand-painted bird motifs, the blue, green and brown borders, Rothschild Garden, and how to choose motifs.
- [Herend Queen Victoria China](https://herendchina.com/queen-victoria/): Herend Queen Victoria, the butterfly-and-flower pattern from 1851: its three colorways, its teapots, and how it differs from Princess Victoria.
- [Herend Princess Victoria China](https://herendchina.com/princess-victoria/): Herend Princess Victoria puts the Queen Victoria rim on plain white. See its nine colors at Paris Tableware, the decor codes, and how to pair it.
- [Herend Chinese Bouquet China in Every Color](https://herendchina.com/chinese-bouquet/): Herend Chinese Bouquet in all seven colors, from green to black sapphire: decor codes, the Garland version, teapots and mugs, and how to choose a color.
- [Herend Apponyi: The Pattern Sold in the US as Chinese Bouquet](https://herendchina.com/apponyi/): Herend Apponyi is the manufactory's name for Chinese Bouquet. Who Count Apponyi was, how the color codes translate, and how to match pieces in the US.
- [Herend Golden Edge China](https://herendchina.com/golden-edge/): Herend Golden Edge is white porcelain with fine gold lines. What the range includes, how it pairs with painted patterns, and Golden Edge vs Platinum Edge.

## Setting and caring for the table

- [Herend Tea Sets and Teaware](https://herendchina.com/tea-sets/): How to put together a Herend tea set: teapot sizes from 12 to 84 oz, rose, butterfly and bird knobs, cup shapes, mugs, creamers and sugars.
- [Setting a Herend Table: Place Settings and Sizes](https://herendchina.com/place-settings/): What a five-piece Herend place setting includes, the size of every plate, how many settings to buy, and how to build a Herend service over time.
- [Caring for Herend China](https://herendchina.com/care/): How to wash Herend china, why gold-trimmed pieces stay out of the dishwasher and microwave, how to store plates and cups, and how to replace a piece.
- [Herend China on a Wedding Registry](https://herendchina.com/wedding-registry/): How to put Herend china on a wedding registry: which pattern to start with, what a list for eight or twelve settings includes, and the ways to register.

## About this site

- [About This Herend China Guide](https://herendchina.com/about/): Who writes this Herend china guide: Paris Tableware, a family-owned store in Ridgewood, New Jersey, since 1982. How the pages are sourced and checked.
- [Shipping and Returns](https://herendchina.com/shipping-returns/): Herend orders from Paris Tableware ship free over $150 ($19 below) within the continental US. Orders placed through Jan 1, 2027 can be returned in 30 days.
- [Privacy and Analytics](https://herendchina.com/privacy/): What this Herend china guide measures, how visits are shared with Paris Tableware, and how to opt out, including Global Privacy Control.
